SHG.why: replaces the one-hot gather matmul; the gathered window still has the attention behind it

KVP.why: projects each atom once instead of four times -- deletes 3 of 4 readers of the same rows, not the last

L1.why: residency: the DRAM readers go away, the tensor's consumers do not

SDPAQ.why: occupancy, not movement -- it deletes no reader at all

QKVG.why: the normed pair tensor is read once instead of twice, and a THIRD reader remains (the 32-wide pair-bias projection)

PWA.why: the normed MSA rows stop being re-read 2*n_heads times; the pair tensor keeps its other consumers

COND.why: deletes a 201 MB host download outright -- nothing else reads it

ZINIT.why: z_init never crosses PCIe; the resident trunk consumes it where it is built

CONF.why: the confidence head reads the pair tensor the trunk already left on device

A_in_session_singles.caveat: three of the four factors are inside their session's bootstrapped floor

A_bitexact_subset.note: BX itself clears its session's floor by 11.7x; none of its three factors clears theirs

falsifier.bar: union more than 5 % BELOW the product of the surviving singles
